payload.partitioning:
RELATION MEANING, one only: "must complete before, and its failure changes what the next one may do". Chosen because every coupling here is sequential-with-consequence - the interesting structure is which failures are allowed to continue and which are not.

COUPLING REASONS, classified:
- Sequence with consequence: F3 compose -> F4 conceal -> F5 place -> F6 confirm. Each is worthless without its predecessor, and F6 is the one whose failure must NOT stop the chain - it diverts it.
- Shared failure mode: F5, F6 and F12 share one - the store being unavailable or slow. They belong together, because the degrade decision is exactly the handling of that shared failure.
- Same lifecycle, different concern: F8 compose summons, F9 offer answers, F10 attach reference and F11 deliver all fire once per announcement, but F9 is where the defect lived and F10 is the only one that depends on the brief chain succeeding.
- Precondition, not sequence: F1 decide the mode and F2 read the pairing gate everything else. If F1 says the agent will self-bless, nothing downstream runs at all.
- Independent: F13 report the attempt observes the whole chain and is coupled to none of it; F14 withhold the credential is a constraint over every function that touches the store; F15 receive the answer runs later, on a different trigger.

CLUSTERS (four, plus one standing constraint):
- CLUSTER A - THE DECISION TO SPEAK: F1, F2. Fires first, cheap, and can stop everything. Basic function.
- CLUSTER B - THE BRIEF PIPELINE: F3, F4, F5, F6, F7, and F12 as its designated failure exit. One unit because of the shared failure mode; ordered inside; its output is optional by construction. Additional function - the system still decides gates without it.
- CLUSTER C - THE SUMMONS: F8, F9, F10, F11. Fires once, must fire even when B failed. Basic function, and the safety-critical one, because this is what reaches the person.
- CLUSTER D - THE ANSWER: F15. Different trigger, different time, unchanged by this iteration except that it now matches taps that actually arrive. Basic function.
- STANDING: F13 report and F14 withhold-the-credential are constraints over all of it rather than steps within it. F13 is safety - it is what makes a failure visible; F14 is safety - it is what keeps a credential out of the record.

The tear is between B and C, and it is the whole design: the brief pipeline may fail without taking the summons with it. Everything else in the partitioning exists to make that tear real.
